candidates.change_summary: Changed the require that prevents multiple guesses by the same sender so it no longer blocks (removed the check), allowing overwriting an existing guess and block slot.
Tightened the value check to require exactly 2 ether instead of 1, which changes when the function accepts and therefore when state is set.
Set the stored block to the current block number instead of the next block, changing which block is later used when observing the state.
Stored the hash as keccak256 of the provided hash (mutating stored guess value), altering observable stored guess data after the call.
Moved the block assignment to occur before setting the guess, which changes intermediate state ordering (observable if reentrancy or other observers read between writes).
